hop_glosses: Hop 1 identifies the material via doping-modified conductivity; hop 2 supplies what two differently doped regions form.

sufficient_sets.text: Its conductivity can be modified by adding impurities ("doping") to its crystal structure.
When two regions with different doping levels are present in the same crystal, they form a semiconductor junction.

text: The material whose conductivity can be modified by adding impurities to its crystal structure forms what when two differently doped regions share a crystal?
